status: REAL RESULT — rank #7 by E-distance (gate-passing). Interpreted as a DE-PRIORITIZED brake (tumor-suppressor transformation risk), NOT a lead nominee.
modality_context: KO (Shifrut/Marson primary human CD8 T-cell CRISPR-KO); concordance rule: concordant = protective_lof

real_result.interpretation: Modest causal transcriptional footprint (E=1.79, ~4x below the RASA2/CBLB brake tier). Passes the significance + viability gates but viability_ratio 0.75 shows KO REDUCES recovered cell number — consistent with p27 loss deregulating the cell cycle rather than cleanly enhancing effector fitness.

ensembl_expected: ENSG00000111276 (literature; unverified — OT unavailable this run to confirm)

identifiers.chembl_target_note: SINGLE PROTEIN target 'Cyclin-dependent kinase inhibitor 1B' (P46527). ChEMBL also lists PROTEIN-PROTEIN INTERACTION target CHEMBL3885557 (CDKN1B/SKP2) — the SCF(Skp2) degradation node, not CDKN1B itself.

io_rationale: p27Kip1 is a CDK inhibitor and a G1/S cell-cycle BRAKE; in T cells it restrains proliferative expansion, so KO can lower the threshold for clonal expansion. But p27 is a canonical TUMOR SUPPRESSOR — germline LoF causes MEN4 (multiple endocrine neoplasia type 4). Removing it from an engineered cell product trades effector expansion against oncogenic-transformation and genomic-instability risk. Effect size here is modest and its readout looks proliferative rather than a clean effector-program shift.

tractability.evidence: ChEMBL target CHEMBL3758070 with ~20 PDB structures and Pharos listing, BUT CDKN1B is a largely intrinsically-disordered endogenous CDK inhibitor — direct small-molecule inhibition is classically hard, and the therapeutic goal (release the brake) means REDUCING p27, not inhibiting a pocket. The tractable node is its degradation machinery (SKP2/SCF, CHEMBL3885557), not CDKN1B itself.

genetic_evidence.anchor_disease: Multiple endocrine neoplasia type 4 (MEN4) — rare germline CDKN1B LoF, tumor-predisposition; Mendelian, not common-variant immune GWAS
genetic_evidence.rationale: Human CDKN1B LoF is a cancer-predisposition (tumor-suppressor) signature, not an immune disease-risk GWAS direction. Excluded from the common-variant directional funnel (any_gwas=false) and reinforces the transformation-risk flag rather than supporting an enhancement KO.

known_drugs.action_types: none (no approved/clinical drug directly inhibits CDKN1B)
known_drugs.note: No drug directly targets p27 as an inhibitable enzyme; modulation is indirect via the SCF(Skp2) degradation axis. No CDKN1B-directed clinical program.

active_trials.note: Zero interventional programs naming CDKN1B/p27 as the agent — consistent with an undruggable tumor-suppressor node.

essentiality.note: Not pan-essential; a cell-cycle regulator / tumor suppressor. Loss deregulates proliferation.

safety_flags: TUMOR-SUPPRESSOR KO — oncogenic-transformation and genomic-instability risk in an engineered T-cell product (MEN4 germline precedent).
In-screen viability_ratio 0.75 (reduced recovery) — readout looks proliferative/fitness-linked rather than a clean effector enhancement.
call: DE-PRIORITIZE — modest effect size + tumor-suppressor transformation risk + no direct tractability. Not a lead; retained for funnel completeness (gate-passing hit #7).
